mechanism: Indomethacin may increase mefloquine levels by reducing renal clearance and potentially inhibiting metabolism, while mefloquine can increase indomethacin CNS toxicity and gastrointestinal risk.
action: Monitor closely for mefloquine neurotoxicity (dizziness, neuropsychiatric symptoms) and indomethacin GI adverse effects; consider alternative antimalarial or NSAID if possible.
